sn33.1:1.2: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yena Bhagavā tenupa-saṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn33.1:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn33.1:1.4: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
sn33.1:1.5: Sassato loko ti va Asassato loko ti vā || Antavā loko ti vā Anantavā loko ti vā || Taṃ jīvam taṃ sarīranti vā Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sariranti va || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathagato param maraṇā ti vā || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇa ti vā ti || || 4
sn33.1:1.6: Rūpe kho Vaccha aññāṇā rūpasamudaye aññāṇā rūpanirodhe aññāṇā rūpanirodhagaminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā ||
sn33.1:1.7: evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti ||
sn33.1:1.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāpato paraṃ maraṇāti vā ti || ||
sn33.1:1.10: Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yena anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
sn33.1:1.11: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.1:1.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti || || 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam
